meta.title: Vicimus — Software development and digital solutions
meta.description: Digital systems that drive real business growth. Custom software, web platforms and integrated ecosystems, from Oradea.

hero.headline: Digital systems that drive business growth.
hero.subheadline: Vicimus is an innovative software development and technology company. We turn modern technology into business results — web systems, custom software and end-to-end digital ecosystems, from a single partner.

about.heading: Where technology becomes business value.
about.p1: We build systems that don't just work — they measurably improve efficiency, customer relationships and revenue opportunities. Whether it's web systems, custom software or integrated ecosystems, our goal is for technology to deliver business outcomes.
about.p2: We believe great software is more than a tool — it's a competitive advantage. We build technology that makes companies simpler, more efficient and more profitable to operate.

values.title: Business-driven development
values.body: We don't just write code — we solve business problems with technology.

values.title: Scalable systems
values.body: Our solutions are built to grow alongside your business.

values.title: Integrated operations
values.body: We connect sales, marketing, customer relations and operations into one platform.

values.title: Ongoing support
values.body: We stay by your side after launch: maintenance, development, optimization.

services.heading: We build custom software, not templates.
services.intro: Four focus areas cover the full digital scope of our partner companies — from custom systems to data-driven decision making.

items.title: Custom software development
items.body: Tailored systems that fit business needs exactly. We automate processes, reduce manual work and build scalable solutions.

items.title: Web systems and platforms
items.body: Modern, fast and secure web applications that support sales, customer management and internal operations.

items.title: Digital ecosystems
items.body: Integrated systems that unite sales, marketing, customer support and data analysis into a single cohesive platform.

items.title: Data-driven business solutions
items.body: We help you interpret and use your data so your business can make faster, more accurate decisions.

contact.heading: Let's get in touch.
contact.supporting: Have an idea or a business challenge? We'll help you make it happen — we usually reply within 24 hours.

footer.tagline: Vicimus — where technology becomes business value.
